summary: Design and govern AI use cases for credit, risk, collections, and service. Build practical dashboards, controls, and implementation roadmaps.
lede: AI-augmented banking operations training shows you how to move from promising artificial intelligence pilots to controlled processes that support credit decisioning, collections, fraud monitoring, and customer service. You will learn to prioritize use cases, assess data readiness, clarify accountability, manage vendors, and protect fair customer treatment and data protection. Through practical exercises, you will create core governance and operating artefacts, including a use-case scoring matrix, model inventory, risk register, monitoring dashboard, service workflow, and escalation process. The course also covers model validation, performance thresholds, impact reporting, and management decision records, with reference points including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, IFRS 9 expected credit loss processes, operational resilience principles, and the Three Lines Model.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who commission, govern, operate, or measure AI-enabled financial services processes. It suits beginner-to-intermediate AI practitioners who understand their business function and need a structured route from use-case selection to controlled execution.
modules: AI Risk and Vendor Due Diligence
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of at least one financial-services function, such as credit, risk, operations, technology, customer service, or product management. Familiarity with lending processes, insurance operations, or cooperative-finance workflows will help, but prior machine-learning development is not required. No coding or programming is required for completion. Advanced AI topics such as automated decisioning architecture and machine-learning model development receive conceptual awareness and operational application treatment, while use-case assessment, dashboard design, vendor review, and governance planning receive hands-on treatment.
